verdict.rationale: WorkOS explicitly documents that its API/SDK exposes the same operations as the dashboard, and its MCP server lets AI agents 'read and change the same dashboard data you can (managing organizations, connections, users, branding, and more) by calling the WorkOS API on your behalf,' with the MCP endpoint verified live (401 requiring OAuth, confirming it's a real, gated service). Extensive first-party docs across SSO, Directory Sync, RBAC, Audit Logs, Vault, and RBAC further show API coverage of core admin functions typically done in UI. Missing for 10: an independent/hands-on audit confirming 100% feature parity (no dashboard-only features left API-inaccessible) and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s for openapi.json/swagger.json paths).
